scientific_dependency.finding_available_before_freeze: The authenticated layer-0 complete-block PTQ candidate reduced validation NMSE by 80.3356% versus direct ternary. The three-block PTQ and QAT gates were still running or unrun when this kernel experiment was frozen.

hypothesis: Fuse the deployable affine-base3 equation into the successful output-row SIMD schedule: interleave sixteen output rows, broadcast each CQ8 activation word once, compute exact centered ternary dots in two AVX2 vectors, and add the mu times group-sum term before applying the shared activation scale. Decode the compressed alpha and mu ratios directly from one combined index byte per row/group, so no FP16/BF16 weight matrix or per-group scale matrix is materialized.

runtime_layout.name: AFF3_X16
runtime_layout.row_anchors: one FP16 alpha anchor and one signed FP16 mu anchor per output row
runtime_layout.codebooks: one 16-entry FP16 alpha ratio table and one 16-entry signed FP16 mu ratio table per tensor
runtime_layout.index_byte: low nibble is alpha ratio index; high nibble is mu ratio index
runtime_layout.code_layout: group-major, then sixteen-weight input chunk, then output row; each chunk has two adjacent 32-byte AVX2 vectors for rows 0-7 and 8-15
runtime_layout.tail_policy: Use an eight-row affine tile, then an ordinary affine row kernel for output-row tails.

kernel_algebra.stored_weight: w[g,j] = mu_anchor[row] * mu_codebook[mu_index[row,g]] + alpha_anchor[row] * alpha_codebook[alpha_index[row,g]] * trit[row,g,j]
kernel_algebra.lane_mapping: two AVX2 vectors hold sixteen independent output rows
kernel_algebra.ratio_decode: split sixteen combined index bytes into alpha and mu nibbles, gather FP32-converted codebook entries, and multiply by FP32-converted row anchors
kernel_algebra.butterfly_execution: apply six sparse Givens stages once to the normalized activation at each fan-out site, then quantize the rotated activation once and reuse it for every consumer

gate_4_model_integration.minimum_deeper_coverage: all rank-2 text projection tensors in a separately authenticated candidate

stop_rules: Stop before timing on any artifact authentication, exact mapping, integer algebra, finiteness, or runtime-memory failure.
Reject the native candidate if either frozen material speed threshold or either frozen stability threshold fails.
Do not benchmark while the affine PTQ or QAT service is consuming the four-core host.
Do not promote into the full model unless the separately preregistered three-block QAT gate passes.
Do not run capability evaluation unless the integrated performance gate passes.
Do not infer a score for an unrun gate and do not convert a primitive pass into a model-level claim.
claim_boundary: A native pass would establish a fused low-bit affine-base3 AVX2 GEMV primitive with bounded runtime memory for Qwen3.8-27B shapes. Only a separately authenticated all-text-projection artifact plus end-to-end speed, memory, free-generation, CUTE, MATH, MMLU, and WikiText receipts can support a CPU-inference breakthrough claim.
